claim: Source and documentation review of LuxAlgo/PineTS at commit c5e6b0efee7e42d78b42d96f14173f38be082551 (license AGPL-3.0), read from README.md at that commit. Repository description: "Run Pine Script® anywhere. PineTS is an open-source transpiler and runtime that brings Pine Script® logic to Node.js and the browser with 1:1 syntax compatibility. Reliably write, port, and run indicators or strategies on your own infrastructure.". Survived the landscape-sweep-20261009-pine facts refuter and both fit refuters (Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6-Astra); no native install, run or comparison with a winner.

documentation_excerpts.text: PineTS is a TypeScript runtime for [Pine Script®](https://www.TradingView.com/pine-script-docs/welcome/). It transpiles native v6 or v5 source and executes it with the same time series model: lookbacks, incremental TA, and plot outputs you can read from code.
You write the indicator once. PineTS runs it on your data, in your process.
